scope: Complete labelled Seidel-switch classification of Paley(13), with shared explicit first-obstruction records and saved conditional queries; no general Ramsey-number or asymptotic claim.

formal_problem.question: Does R(k)/(k*2^(k/2)) tend to infinity?
formal_problem.annotation: research open; source annotation only, no exhaustive current literature claim.

paley.authors: Tian Khoon Lim and Cheryl E. Praeger
paley.title: On Generalised Paley Graphs and Their Automorphism Groups

seidel.authors: A. E. Brouwer and W. H. Haemers
seidel.title: Spectra of Graphs
seidel.custody: Exact indexed primary-book excerpt supplied by source scout; direct source routes unavailable, not retried.

conventions.graph: Labelled finite simple undirected graph; its red edge set and blue complement colour every unordered distinct pair.
conventions.paley_input: F_13 with vertices 0..12, nonzero square differences red.
conventions.gauge: s(0)=0; complementary switch sets induce the same colouring and exactly one remains.
conventions.ranking: Increasing integer code; vertex v>=1 has weight 2^(v-1). Not lexicographic order of selected-vertex lists.
conventions.no_further_quotient: Graph isomorphisms and global color interchange are not identified.
conventions.target: No monochromatic K4 in either colour.
conventions.condition: Only members of this fixed switch orbit are eligible; not arbitrary edge completions.
conventions.empty_family: Forced-bit and forced-edge values are null, avoiding vacuous double forcing.

input_graph.provenance: Paley prime-field graph from Lim-Praeger, Introduction: https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0605252

source_details.prime_contract: The convenience interface supports the fixed primes 5, 13 and 17 only; it is not a general prime-power field constructor.

complete_finite_consequence.interpretation: The 12 single-vertex switches away from vertex0 and the complement representative of the vertex0 switch; a finite orbit minimum, not a universal graph statement.
complete_finite_consequence.derivation: Read from the retained complete classification; no second switch computation.

validation_scope.executed: One Paley(13) instantiation and one new complete switch-family compiler call, followed by one fresh saved-reader load and 14 queries.
validation_scope.unexecuted: Other graph inputs, q=5/q=17 convenience cases, larger caps and contradiction/refusal paths were source-inspected, not executed in a synthetic suite.
validation_scope.loader: Structural graph/table consistency and the one retained first-cube match for each excluded mask; queried obstructions evaluate their six edges. No Paley reconstruction, local-pattern compilation or all-cube expansion.
validation_scope.scope_limit: The original colouring is included as part of the complete finite switch family; no separate source-baseline verification or Ramsey-number search was run.
validation_scope.timing: Individual connected-V8 observations, not a statistical benchmark.
